corrections.text: The article states the Ant Group/AgiBot joint venture, Hangzhou Chuanzhi Future Technology, "was established on November 11, 2025." The cited TechNode report describes the venture only as "recently established" and is itself dated November 11, 2025; it does not identify November 11 as the establishment date. The venture's registered capital (RMB 20 million / $2.75 million) and ownership are accurate as reported.
